falseSynonyms.zh: 退休人士不等於所有 older people 退休是就業狀態，不是年齡定義；有人提早退休，也有長者繼續工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Retirement status and age are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 領退休金人士不等於所有 older people 是否領取退休金取決於制度與資格。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pension status is not the same as age.

falseSynonyms.zh: 祖父母不等於 older people 有人年長但不是祖父母，也有人較年輕已成為祖父母。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Family role is not an age category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可理解但較容易把人變成一個標籤 現代包容語體通常更偏好 elderly people / older people，而非把 elderly 單獨名詞化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Person-first wording is often preferable.

falseSynonyms.zh: senior 單獨使用有多義 可指年長人士，也可指職級較高的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Senior can refer to age or rank.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成年人範圍太廣 adult 包括所有成年年齡層。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Adult is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在代際比較 sense 接近 它把人作為一整代比較，而不是一般年齡群體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Generation framing is context-specific.

falseSynonyms.zh: 語用陷阱 old 可直接表示年老，但形容人時可能較生硬；older people 通常更中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Older is generally more neutral for people.
